results.title: The Matchmaker
results.overview: Amar is a creature of habit — quiet, solitary, and most at home among his matchboxes. So when a shy colleague at the match factory works up the courage to ask him out, his instinct isn’t to say yes. It isn’t even to say no. Instead, he decides to play matchmaker — steering her toward the charming regular at the village pub. A tidy solution. Except, of course, it isn’t.

results.title: Chris Locke: Tiki Madness
results.overview: Chris Locke gets loose and silly in a Tiki bar while his bartender friend Arno serves him cocktails. There’s classic stand up jokes, hilarious improvisational riffs, sound effects, dancing, and classic attention deficit madness for these bonkers times.  Filmed at the Drake Underground in Toronto.

results.title: EVE 144: The Multiverse Rumble
results.overview: The door to the multiverse will be opened - what will come through?!  In the past we've seen Susan Cage, 'Peter Kay', 'Ivory' X3, Gran Like Dereiss, 3 different versions of 'John Cena', K-O Kasey Owens, The Greatest Showman, Rayne-O-Mac and bizarrely Will Ospreay vs 'Triple H' among many others we can't even begin to describe - what will the 2026 edition bring?!

results.title: Karen the Beauty Queen Butcher
results.overview: Karen an unhappy married woman joins several Beauty Contests in the hope of being famous and adored by complete strangers. As she continues to lose beauty contests, we see that her competition is being killed off one by one. As we follow Karen's journey through the film we discover who is the killer and what are the true motivations behind the murders.

results.title: Gorky Resort
results.overview: The year is 1939. The world is falling into chaos. Thousands of Poles, held by the Russians in a former monastery, are subjected to brutal indoctrination. An ambitious enemy agent makes it a point of honour to break the resistance of one of them. He is a young, world-famous pianist, respected by his fellow prisoners. His capitulation may result in winning many others over to the enemy's side. An insidious game begins, full of sophisticated manipulation, threats and promises. Can the young artist, a loving father and husband, win a duel with an agent backed by the power and perfidy of the Russian system?

results.title: Broken Bonds
results.overview: After witnessing a fatal shootout, three struggling waitresses hide a bag of illicit cash, forcing them into a perilous web of betrayal and survival.

results.title: Mistletoe Massacre
results.overview: Marion Callevero has her guest list checked twice to host the company Christmas event, but gifts quickly turn to gore. This struggling staff has been invited to the party but no one will be returning home for the holidays.

results.title: Shesha 2016
results.overview: Shesha 2016 is a gripping crime thriller set over one chaotic night at a remote police station on the Karnataka-Kerala border. When an abusive officer is brutally murdered, a lone female cop gets trapped in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a cryptic caller. It’s a gritty, fast-paced watch filled with intense suspense and dark secrets.

results.title: Bankzitters: Ziggo Dome 2026 (Mini Docu)
results.overview: In this video, we take you behind the scenes of our five Ziggo Dome shows and the days leading up to them. No filter, no script, just plenty of chaos and stress.

results.title: Caeneus
results.overview: When Caenis sees Caeneus on a punk stage, they know they want his body. Desire, envy and pain intertwine as Caenis obsessively hunts for Caeneus - and their true self.

results.title: Ye Live in Georgia
results.overview: Ye performs in Georgia as part of the "BULLY" Tour on June 12, 2026.

results.title: Shabab Albomb 3
results.overview: Amer plans to travel with his friends this summer, but his desire clashes with his family's insistence on accompanying them as well. The problem seems minor at first, but it pales in comparison to the surprises that await them upon their arrival.

results.title: Promoter Boudi
results.overview: Shanti, known as Promoter Boudi, plans to build an old-age home and orphanage on a prime plot, but a ruthless developer wants it for a shopping mall. As past secrets resurface, a battle begins between compassion and greed.

results.overview: A Mini-Series from the fifth season of The Patrick Star Show containing the episodes "Gone Bootin'," Roller Bunny," "Squ-AD-ina," "Don't Friend the Reaper." and "Pat Alone... At Home"

results.title: Finale: Allegro
results.overview: An old lady left alone seriously thinks about suicide, when a young woman suddenly bursts into her life and puts her into a vortex of suspicions, generosity, ambiguity, which will give her back a glimmer of life and joy, even if final.
